primary_sensor_contract: 15 common numerical MTConnect channels, six statistics each; no metadata predictors
alternative_sensor_contract: VM20i raw acc0/acc1, same six statistics, considered separately; never substituted silently into the common-MTC vector
visual_minimum: recognizable spindle and workpiece/cutting context in the 16 sampled frames; partial coolant occlusion allowed and flagged; no claim of visible tool damage
preprocessing_prototype: sample-aspect correction followed by aspect-preserving letterbox to 224x224 RGB; 16 ordered frames; no learned transform
